import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Fix the import in NPCRelationshipSystem to use the guild version
print('=== Fixing NPCRelationshipSystem import ===')

# Check what the guild version looks like
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('head -10 /root/opt/areloria/server/src/modules/guild/TerritoryControl.ts')

print(stdout.read().decode())

# Update NPCRelationshipSystem to import from the correct path
cmd = \"sed -i 's|from \\\"../territory/TerritoryControl\\\"|from \\\"../guild/TerritoryControl\\\"|' /root/opt/areloria/server/src/modules/npc/NPCRelationshipSystem.ts\"
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command(cmd)
print('Updated import path')

# Verify
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('head -5 /root/opt/areloria/server/src/modules/npc/NPCRelationshipSystem.ts')
print('\\n=== Updated import ===')
print(stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
"
